How this hub is built & what still needs a human

What's real vs. pending here

  • Roster: the 11 Tasmania players on this page (Deng is not on it). Groups per Markus, 11 Nov 2026: Starters = Armstrong, Mathias, Johnson, Bannan, Magnay; Rotation = Stoddart, Stattmann, Bayles; Bench = Ayre, plus Marshall and Gold, both injured (locked cards, not counted in the recall totals, left out of the Summary columns and the Stats table).
  • Archetypes, designations, PnR calls, scout notes and recall questions come from the Oct-17 Tasmania hub (TAS-2026-10-21). Stoddart and Ayre were not in that hub, so their notes and recall questions are carried over from the earlier Tasmania hub and are older than the rest. Their photos are that hub's cut-outs placed on the same green background as the other cards.
  • Team Overview (v20): Keys to Victory is PACE & PRESSURE; the Offensive Keys and Defensive Keys slides (Tasmania title slides G14) are rebuilt as live panels in place of the Starting Defense / Starting Offense tables; the Matchup Overview lists each Bullets player with the Tasmania players he is matched on (Markus, 11 Nov 2026). Team Recall is 5 questions on the keys; Game Situations (the player-card recall) is 4 (Johnson, Mathias, Armstrong, Stoddart). The target marker is now on Stoddart only (removed from Armstrong and Mathias).
  • Stats Summary: C&S and Off Dribble 3P% are the Opponent Shooting #s sheet's "last N years" totals (Tasmania tab, read 11 Nov; blank under 20 attempts). 3PA Rate, FT% and FT Rate are RealGM (pulled 11 Nov), pooled over 2023-24 to 2026-27 regular seasons, all competitions, no Blitz or Intercontinental Cup. ORB% and AST% are the simple average of RealGM's Tasmania Advanced Stats pages for 2024-25, 2025-26 and 2026-27 (Markus's screenshots, 13 Nov), using only the seasons a player was on Tasmania's page: Magnay and Stoddart three, Johnson and Bannan two, the other five one season only. Where RealGM would not return a table the cell is blank, not estimated: Bannan's off-dribble 3P%, and Mathias's and Bannan's 3PA / FT / FT Rate stay as the 29 Sep pull. Every column heading sorts.

Reusing this for the next opponent

Everything on this page is driven by the data arrays at the top of the script - swap in a new opponent's roster and call sheet and the cards, quizzes, print sheet and summary rebuild themselves.
